title: se-proservices-integration-standup-blitz-2026-03-25
notes:
Purpose: rapid standup + focused blocker hunt for 4 active integrations. Short window (30m) — capture status, escalate, assign owners for immediate wins.

Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Liam Chen, Sofia Martinez, Jordan Blake, Priya Raman, guest: Marco Ruiz (customer success - NimbusRetail).

Agenda:
- Quick status per customer (2–3 min each)
- Critical blockers and mitigation plan
- Request list for infra/eng and timeline
- Confirm next checkpoints and on-call handoffs

Summary: overall progress on-week is steady; two accounts (NimbusRetail, Orchid Insurance) have priority blockers that require infra/security escalation. Cerebra Analytics on track with model pin and performance tests; BlueMarble Finance needs an integration-quality audit for embedding drift.

1) NimbusRetail (Priority: P0 -> P1 after mitigation)- Current: Data ingestion pipeline validated, initial end-to-end test fails when sequence length spikes >1024 (requests timeout after 1.1s beyond SLO).- Root cause hypothesis: KV cache warmup edge-case + suboptimal kernel selection for long sequences on current instance type. Observed higher CPU on CPU-bound preprocess stage.- Actions taken in meeting: rolled canary traffic to quantized-compat model variant (qm-1.2) to keep latency flat while infra investigates.- Blockers: needs temporary routing rule to prefer low-latency AZ; requires network egress exception from Nimbus infra team for 3 hours for a full trace capture (ticket created).- Tickets: JIRA-SE-4410 (kv-cache-diagnostics), JIRA-INFRA-2374 (network-egress-exception).- Owner(s): Liam Chen (technical lead), Marco Ruiz (customer liaison).- ETA: trace window scheduled 2026-03-27 02:00-05:00 UTC.

2) Orchid Insurance (Priority: P0 - compliance blocker)- Current: Private deployment (VPC) onboarding stalled; customer requires HSM-backed key wrapping + audit trail for all inference requests (PCI-style control).- Root cause: Private control-plane default only had KMS integration; HSM provisioning needs vendor approval and network zoning adjustments.- Decision: escalate to Security & Compliance and Partner Ops; cannot proceed without HSM proof-of-concept.- Action: open enterprise escalation, draft customer-facing timeline and mitigation (fallback: dedicated reserved capacity with enhanced logging until HSM is provisioned).- Tickets: JIRA-SEC-1259, JIRA-PS-889.- Owner(s): Sofia Martinez (account lead), Priya Raman (security liaison).- ETA: initial vendor response expected by 2026-03-30.

3) Cerebra Analytics (Priority: P2)- Current: Model pinning complete; running perf suite for 1M token workload. Throughput meets target but 99th percentile latency jitter at long-tail tokens seen in synthetic stress tests.- Findings: jitter correlates with garbage-collection bursts in host-side preprocess container. Suggested short-term tweak: increase JVM heap slack for preprocessing step and enable smaller GC intervals. Long-term: move preprocess into replicated stateless pods to spread jitter.- Action: Jordan to prototype preprocess pod split and run A/B perf.- Tickets: JIRA-SE-4397.- Owner(s): Jordan Blake.- ETA: prototype by 2026-04-02.

4) BlueMarble Finance (Priority: P1)- Current: embedding drift detected vs. baseline after switching tokenizer update; similarity scores differ ~6% for high-value queries.- Hypothesis: tokenizer update changed tokenization boundaries for finance-specific shorthand, causing embedding model to weight segments differently.- Next steps: run differential eval using previous tokenizer + current model to quantify regression and produce rollback decision matrix. Also request a small sample of flagged queries from customer for targeted prompt engineering.- Tickets: JIRA-PS-894.- Owner(s): Priya Raman.- ETA: data sample requested; 2026-03-29 for first differential eval.

Operational/Platform notes:
- Autoscaler tuning: observed one incident where dedicated pool autoscaler mis-estimated demand after a sudden burst (seen 2026-03-23 14:12 UTC). Root cause preliminary points at metric lag and batching policy threshold. Eng infra assigned INFRA-2345. Recommended temporary manual scale-up for high-throughput customers during marketing events.
- Canary rollouts: agreed to add a gating check for sequence-length distribution (sampled 1%) before promoting a model variant to 100% traffic. Liam to add to rollout template.

Decisions made:
- Use quantized-compat variant for NimbusRetail until KV-cache trace is analyzed.
- Escalate Orchid HSM need to Security; offer Dedicated as stopgap if vendor timeline slips.
- Add sequence-length precheck to rollout gating.

Open risks:
- If HSM vendor delays >2 weeks, Orchid may request contract pause.
- Autoscaler metric lag could impact peak-day SLAs for multiple customers; need infra fix prioritized.

Meeting notes: informal items and scraps- Quick reminder: update the onboarding checklist with a KMS/HSM checkbox under private-deployments.- Put a 1hr deep-dive next Tuesday for NimbusRetail to walk through KV-cache internals with runtime team.

Next checkpoints:- NimbusRetail: trace window 2026-03-27, debrief 2026-03-27 12:00 UTC.- Orchid: vendor update expected 2026-03-30, follow-up with customer 2026-03-31.- Cerebra: prototype report 2026-04-02.- BlueMarble: differential eval results 2026-03-29.

Meeting adjourned: 00:31 (30m). Quick wins assigned; next weekly blitz scheduled 2026-04-01.

Notes captured by: Aisha Patel.
